cards.title: Order of operations
cards.body: As in school maths, `*` and `/` happen before `+` and `-`. Use brackets to change the order.

cards.title: Maths with variables
cards.body: Store numbers in variables, then calculate with their names.
cards.code:
price = 4
count = 3
total = price * count
print(total)
